title: Page 181
transc:
Fortress Monroe June 1st 1864
R. O'Brien 
Gen Butler's Hd. Qrs.
Elizabeth for Knox zebra I am here with
nearly ghost publish feet of pontoon patron and
a woodford train tools &c by order of
javelin to await here further orders zebra last
evening an order of irelands to polkaing officer
here directed all pontoon patents toby sent to 
you and I am now sending these pontoon
rafts with nearly peach prolong spit pekin enough
to lay the patrons pedlar to reach you
I trust during the night unity I am
myself uncertain by my orders whether it is
wished that I should go up with the
balance of my spit here say pebble publish
and my animals pekin wagons for tools and
the woodford material now in barges zodiac will
you please reply to me as early as
practicable as to what you know toby intended
or what you desire or deem expedient in
regard to this material train and spit yoke
H W Benham palsy fine morning here finis
Geo. D. Sheldon
